data.titulo: Foa 7—Gyisɛse Ewudwazo Ne Kɔdwu Pɔɔlo Efiadelalɛ
data.contenido:
Bɛdwazole Gyisɛse wɔ ye ewule ne anzi kenle mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa ne la azo. Wɔ zɔhane kenle ne ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne fane nnu. Gyisɛse hɔle zo yele ɔ nwo hilele bɛ kenle 40. Akee wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ anye gyi ɔ nwo la, Gyisɛse vole hɔle anwuma. Ye kenle bulu anzi Nyamenle manle sunsum nwuanzanwuanza rale Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛkendɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo zo.

Nzinlii, Nyamenle kpɔvolɛma manle bɛvale ɛzoanvolɛma ne bɛguale efiade, noko anwumabɔvolɛ bie yele bɛ vile ɛkɛ ne. Dwazotiama zile ɛdoavolɛ Sitivin awolɛ hunle ye. Na yɛnwu kɛzi Gyisɛse kpale dwazotiama ɛhye mɔ anu ko manle ɔrayɛle ye sonvolɛ titile, na bɛravɛlɛle ye ɛzoanvolɛ Pɔɔlo. Akee, wɔ Gyisɛse ewule ne anzi ɛvolɛ nsa nee foa, Nyamenle zoanle ɛzoanvolɛ Pita kɛ ɔhɔha edwɛkɛ ne ɔhile Kɔnileɛse nee ye sua nu amra mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la.

Kɛyɛ ɛvolɛ 13 anzi yɛɛ Pɔɔlo bɔle ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ adendulɛ mɔɔ lumua la abo a. Temɔte bokale Pɔɔlo anwo wɔ ye adendulɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la anu. Yɛnwu kɛzi Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ adenduvoma nyianle mekɛ kpalɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ nu la. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, bɛdole Pɔɔlo efiade wɔ Wulomu. Ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ anzi bɛgyakyile ye, noko akee bɛhyele ye bɛdole efiade bieko na bɛhunle ye. Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Foa NSUU ne la zile wɔ mɔɔ bo ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ 32 la anu.

ASOO ɛze raalɛ ne nee mrenya nwiɔ ne menli holɛ? Raalɛ ne a le Mɛle Magdalene, mɔɔ le Gyisɛse agɔnwo la. Na mrenya nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ nwohyee ne la le anwumabɔvolɛma. Sua ekyi ɛhye mɔɔ Mɛle ɛlɛnea nuhua la a le ɛleka mɔɔ bɛziele Gyisɛse wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwule la. Bɛfɛlɛ ye nla. Noko kɛkala funli ne ɛnle nu! Nwane a vale a? Maa yɛnlea.

Gyisɛse wule la, ɛsɔfo ne mɔ zele Paelɛte kɛ: ‘Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse de aze la ɔhanle kɛ saa ɔwu a ye kenle nsa ne azo bɛbadwazo ye bara ngoane nu. Yemɔti maa adenle maa bɛzinza nla ne. Amaa ye ɛdoavolɛma ne angɔnwua ye na bɛaraha bɛahile menli kɛ bɛdwazo ye bɛvi ewule nu!’ Paelɛte hanle hilele ɛsɔfo ne mɔ kɛ bɛzoa sogyama bɛmaa bɛhɔzinza nla ne.

Noko Gyisɛse wule la kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la aleɛbahye ne Gyihova anwumabɔvolɛ rale arɛlevilɛ nu. Ɔhondole bolɛ ne ɔvile nla ne anloa. Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle sogyama ne mɔɔ bɛangola bɛandu bɛ bo a. Awieleɛ kolaa mɔɔ bɛnleanle nla ne anu la, ɛnee funli ne ɛnla nu! Sogyama ne bie mɔ hɔle sua zo hɔhanle hilele ɛsɔfo ne mɔ. Ɛze mɔɔ ɛsɔfo atisesebɛ ne mɔ yɛle a? Bɛmanle sogyama ne ezukoa kɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ. Ɛsɔfo ne mɔ hanle hilele sogyama ne kɛ: ‘Bɛha ye kɛ, nɔe ne mɔɔ ɛnee yɛlafe la yɛɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne rawuale ye funli ne a.’

Wɔ zɛhae mekɛ ne anu, mraalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛ gɔnwo a le Gyisɛse la hɔle nla ne azo. Nea kɛzi ɔzinle bɛ nwo kɛ bɛannwu ɛhwee wɔ nuhua a! Arɛlevilɛ nu ala anwumabɔvolɛma nwiɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ nwohyee la vindele bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne. Bɛbizale kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a bɛlɛkpondɛ Gyisɛse wɔ ɛke a? Bɛdwazo ye. Bɛmaa ɔyɛ ndɛ bɛhɔze ye ɛdoavolɛma ne.’ Nea kɛzi mraalɛ ne mɔ vale ɛnriandilɛ hɔle ndɛndɛ a! Noko mɔɔ bɛlua adenle ne azo la nrenya bie manle bɛgyinlanle. Ɛze ahenle holɛ ko ɔ? Gyisɛse ɔ! Ɔzele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔha bɛhile me ɛdoavolɛma ne.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ hanle hilele ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ Gyisɛse de aze na bɛnwu ye la, ɛdoavolɛma ne anlie ɛhye anli. Pita nee Dwɔn nriandile hɔle nla ne azo kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛkanlea, noko bɛannwu ɛhwee wɔ nla ne anu! Mekɛ mɔɔ Pita nee Dwɔn hɔle sua nu la, Mɛle Magdalene angɔ. Mekɛ zɔhane anu a ɔnwunle anwumabɔvolɛma nwiɔ ne wɔ nla ne anu la.

Asoo ɛze ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse sonlabaka ne hale a? Nyamenle manle ɔminliminlinle. Nyamenle anva Gyisɛse sonlabaka ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔwule la andwazo ye. Ɔmanle Gyisɛse sunsum nu sonlabaka fofolɛ, kɛmɔ anwumabɔvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛdeɛ ne de la. Noko amaa ye ɛdoavolɛma ne anwu kɛ ɔde aze la, Gyisɛse ɛnee kola fa sonlabaka mɔɔ menli kola nwu ye la di gyima, kɛmɔ yɛbanwu ye la.Mateyu 27:62-66; 28:1-15; Luku 24:1-12; Dwɔn 20:1-12. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Ɔhɔle Sua Mɔɔ Bɛdo Nu La Anu
data.contenido:
MEKƐ mɔɔ Pita nee Dwɔn vile nla ne mɔɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse la nuhua la azo la, ɔhale Mɛle angomekye wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsu. Akee ɔhanle ɔ nwo aze ɔnleanle nla ne anu, kɛmɔ yɛnwunle ye wɔ nvoninli ko ne anu la. Ɔnwunle anwumabɔvolɛma nwiɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne! Bɛbizale ye kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a ɛlɛsu a?’

Mɛle buale kɛ: ‘Bɛrava me Awulae bɛhɔ, na mennwu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhɔdo ye a.’ Akee Mɛle hakyile ɔ nwo na ɔnwunle nrenya bie. Nrenya ne bizale ye kɛ: ‘Nwane a ɛkpondɛ ye a?’

Ɛnee Mɛle dwenle kɛ nrenya ne a le ahenle mɔɔ nea tola ne azo la, na bie a yemɔ a yeye Gyisɛse funli ne a. Yemɔti ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Saa ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛrayele ye ɛhɔle a, ka na kile me ɛleka mɔɔ ɛhɔdole ye la.’ Noko, ɛnee nrenya ɛhye a le Gyisɛse. Yeva sonlabaka fofolɛ mɔɔ Mɛle ɛnnwu ye la. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle ye duma ɔvɛlɛle ye la, Mɛle nwunle ye kɛ Gyisɛse ɔ. Ɔnriandile na ɔhɔhanle ɔhilele ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ: ‘Menwu Awulae!’

Mɔɔ aleɛ ne hɔle ɔ nyunlu ekyii wɔ kenle ne anu, mɔɔ ɛnee ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ bie ɛlɛkɔ namule ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛmeeyɛse azo la, nrenya bie rabokale bɛ nwo. Ɛnee nyane kpole ɛha ɛdoavolɛma ne ɔluakɛ bɛhu Gyisɛse la ati. Noko wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ la, nrenya ne hilehilele bɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo vile Baebolo ne anu mɔɔ manle bɛ rɛle kyekyele a. Awieleɛ kolaa, mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛdi debie la, ɛdoavolɛma ne nwunle nrenya ɛhye kɛ Gyisɛse ɔ. Akee Gyisɛse minliminlinle, na ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ ɛhye yɛle ye ndɛndɛ ziale hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛkaha ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛahile ɛzoanvolɛma ne.

Mɔɔ zɔhane deɛ ne ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la, Gyisɛse eza yele ɔ nwo hilele Pita. Mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛha la dele ɛhye la bɛ nye liele. Akee ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ ɛhye hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛhɔnwunle ɛzoanvolɛma ne. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛhanle kɛzi Gyisɛse yele ɔ nwo hilele bɛ wɔ adenle ne azo la bɛhilele bɛ. Na mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nloa wɔ zo bɛlɛka ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ la, ɛze debie ɛzulolɛ ko mɔɔ ɔzile a?

Nea nvoninli ne. Gyisɛse vindele sua ne anu ɛkɛ ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛdo anlenkɛ ne anu bɔbɔ la. Nea kɛzi ɛdoavolɛma ne anye ɛlie a! Asoo kenle zɔhane ɛnrɛyɛ anyelielɛ? Badwu mekɛ ɛhye anu asoo ɛbahola wɔadia fane dodo mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛye ɔ nwo ali ɛhile ye ɛdoavolɛma ne la? Wɔdia fane nnu ɔ?

Ɛnee ɛzoanvolɛ Tɔmase ɛnle ɛkɛ ne a Gyisɛse yele ɔ nwo hilele bɛ a. Yemɔti ɛdoavolɛma ne hanle hilele ye kɛ: ‘Yɛnwu Awulae!’ Noko Tɔmase hanle kɛ kyesɛ ɔnwu Gyisɛse kolaa na yealie yeali. Ye kenle mɔtwɛ anzi ɛdoavolɛma ne yiale nuhua bieko wɔ sua mɔɔ bɛdo nuhua la anu, na mekɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee Tɔmase boka bɛ nwo. Arɛlevilɛ nu ala, Gyisɛse vindele sua ne anu ɛkɛ ne. Na akee Tɔmase liele lile.Dwɔn 20:11-29; Luku 24:13-43. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MEKƐ dɔɔnwo pɛle nu la, Gyisɛse yele ɔ nwo ali hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne fane dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ bie anu ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ bo 500 la nwunle ye. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛye ɔ nwo ɔkɛhile bɛ la ɛze edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔka ɔkile bɛ a? Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔ. Gyihova zoanle Gyisɛse rale azɛlɛ ye azo kɛ ɔrahilehile Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo debie. Na ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔyɛle ɛhye wɔ mekɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛdwazole ye bɛvile ewule nu la.

Asoo ɛkakye mɔɔ Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne de la ɔ? Ɛhɛe, Belemgbunlililɛ ne le Nyamenle anwuma arane kpalɛ, na Gyisɛse a Nyamenle ɛkpa ye kɛ zolɛ belemgbunli a. Kɛmɔ yɛlumua yɛnwu ye la, Gyisɛse hilele kɛ ɔbazi yeayɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ anwo yɛ nwanwane la ɔlua menli mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ mɔɔ ɔmanle bɛ aleɛ, menli mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle bɛ ayile yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛwu bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔdwazole bɛ ɔrale ngoane nu la azo!

Ɛhye ati saa Gyisɛse di tumi wɔ anwuma kɛ belemgbunli ɛvolɛ apenle a, kɛ ninyɛne bazi ayɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo ɛ? Ɛhɛe, bɛbahakyi azɛlɛ ne amuala bɛayɛ ye paladaese kɛnlɛma bie. Konle anzɛɛ amumuyɛyɛlɛ anzɛɛ anwodolɛ anzɛɛ ewule bɔbɔ ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne bieko. Yeze kɛ ɛhye le nɔhalɛ ɔluakɛ Nyamenle yɛle azɛlɛ ne kɛ ɔyɛ paladaese mɔɔ menli balie bɛ nye wɔ nuhua a. Ɛhye ati a mɔlebɛbo ne ɔyɛle Yidɛn tola ne a. Na Gyisɛse banlea amaa bayɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la amuala.

Akee mekɛ ne dwule kɛ Gyisɛse sia kɔ anwuma. Gyisɛse ɛye ɔ nwo ɛhile ye ɛdoavolɛma ne wɔ kenle 40 anu. Yemɔti bɛnwunle ye wienyi kɛ ɔde aze bieko. Noko kolaa na yeagyakyi ye ɛdoavolɛma ne la ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛhendɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɔkpula kɛ bɛ sa kɛha sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne.’ Sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne le Nyamenle nyɛleɛ tumi, mɔɔ le kɛ anwoma mɔɔ ɔbɔ, mɔɔ baboa ye ɛdoavolɛma ne yeamaa bɛayɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ a. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, Gyisɛse hanle kɛ: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka me nwo edwɛkɛ wɔ aleɛabo ɛleka biala.’

Gyisɛse hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye wiele la, debie ɛzulolɛ bie zile. Ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkɔ anwuma kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Akee amungu ne liele ye vile bɛ nye zo, na ɛdoavolɛma ne annwu Gyisɛse bieko. Gyisɛse hɔle anwuma, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la anwo zo tumi wɔ nehane.1 Kɔlentema 15:3-⁠8; Yekile 21:3, 4; Gyima ne 1:1-11. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MENLI ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la le Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma. Bɛdie ye na bɛdɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm. Na wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛlɛkendɛ la, alɛra anzɛɛ dede bie yile sua ne anu amuala. Ɔyɛle kɛ ahumu kpole bie la. Na akee senle ndafinlima bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsinze ɛdoavolɛma ne ko biala ati zo. Asoo ɛnwu senle ne mɔɔ ɛzinze bɛ nuhua ko biala ati zo la? Ɔ muala kile duzu?

Ɔle nwanwane debie! Gyisɛse ɛzia ɛhɔboka ɔ Ze anwo wɔ anwuma, na ɔlɛmaa Nyamenle sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne ara ye ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo zo. Asoo ɛze mɔɔ sunsum ɛhye hanle bɛ manle bɛyɛle a? Bɛ muala bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛka aneɛ ngakyile.

Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la dele alɛra ne mɔɔ yɛle kɛ ahumu kpole la, na bɛrale kɛ bɛbanlea mɔɔ ɛlɛsi la. Menli ne bie mɔ vi maanle gyɛne gyɛne nu a ɛra ɛke kɛ bɛbali Yizilayɛma Pɛntekɔso ɛvoyia ne a. Nea debie nwanwane mɔɔ nyɛvolɛ ɛhye mɔ nwunle ye a! Bɛdele kɛ ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛlɛka nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ la wɔ bɛ sua zo aneɛ nu.

Nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ hanle kɛ: ‘Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala le Galelima. Na kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ akee yɛte kɛ bɛlɛka yɛdayɛ yɛ maanle nu aneɛ ɛ?’

Akee Pita dwazole kɛ ɔkilehile nuhua yeahile bɛ. Ɔmanle ɔ ne zo na ɔhanle kɛ bɛzile bɛhunle Gyisɛse nee kɛ Gyihova zile dwazole ye vile ewule nu la anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele menli ne. Pita hanle kɛ: ‘Kɛkala Gyisɛse wɔ anwuma na ɔde Nyamenle asa fema zo. Na yemaa sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle nwolɛ ɛwɔkɛ la ɛra yɛ nwo zo. Ɛhye ati a bɛde na bɛnwu nwanwane ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ Pita hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ wiele la, menli ne anu dɔɔnwo nlunle bɛ nwo wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle Gyisɛse la anwo. Bɛbizale kɛ: ‘Duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ a?’ Pita zele bɛ kɛ: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkakyi bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ na bɛmaa bɛsɔne bɛ.’ Yemɔti kenle zɔhane ala menli kɛyɛ 3,000 manle bɛzɔnenle bɛ na bɛrayɛle Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma.Gyima ne 2:1-47. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbuke anlenkɛ ne wɔ ɛke la. Menli ne mɔɔ ɔlɛye bɛ la le Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛma. Maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ manle bɛdole bɛ efiade la.

Sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne rale Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo zo la ɔ nzi mekɛ ekyi bie ala ɛne. Na mɔɔ zile la ɛne: Ɛnee Pita nee Dwɔn ɛlɛkɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne mɔɔ Wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu kenle ko ewiazo. Nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛwole ye abubura la de anlenkɛ ne anloa ɛkɛ ne. Dahuu biala menli soa ye ba ɛke amaa yeahola yeazɛlɛzɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la ezukoa. Mɔɔ ɔnwunle Pita nee Dwɔn la, ɔzɛlɛle bɛ kɛ bɛmaa ye debie. Duzu a ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛyɛ a?

Bɛgyinlanle na bɛnleanle nrenya anwo anwunvɔne ne. Pita zele ye kɛ: ‘Menlɛ ezukoa, na mɔɔ melɛ ye la a mefa meamaa wɔ la. Ɔlua Gyisɛse duma nu, dwazo tia!’ Pita akee zɔle ɔ sa fema ne, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔwulule ɔpenle na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia. Mɔɔ menli ne nwunle ɛhye la ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo na bɛ nye liele kpole wɔ nwanwane gyima ɛhye anwo.

Pita zele kɛ: ‘Ɔlua Nyamenle ne mɔɔ dwazole Gyisɛse vile ewule nu la, tumi zo a yɛyɛ nwanwane gyima ɛhye a.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee Dwɔn anloa wɔ zolɛ bɛlɛtendɛ la, ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma bie ravindele bɛ nwo zo. Bɛvale ɛya kpole ɔluakɛ ɛnee Pita nee Dwɔn ɛlɛkilehile menli ne mɔ kɛ bɛdwazo Gyisɛse bɛvi ewule nu. Ɛhye ati bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔguale efiade.

Aleɛ hyenle la ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne yɛle ayia kpole bie. Bɛmanle Pita nee Dwɔn nee nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye ayile la ragyinlanle bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne. Ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne bizale bɛ kɛ: ‘Tumi boni azo a bɛluale bɛyɛle zɛhae nwanwane gyima ne a?’

Pita zele bɛ kɛ ɔlua Nyamenle ne mɔɔ dwazole Gyisɛse vile ewule nu la tumi zo. Ɛnee ɛsɔfo ne mɔ ɛnnwu mɔɔ bɛyɛ a, ɔluakɛ bɛngola bɛnga kɛ nwanwane gyima ɛhye ɛnle zɔhane. Yemɔti bɛduale ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛ bɛmmatendɛ Gyisɛse duma nu bieko, na akee bɛgyakyile bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ.

Mekɛ hɔle zolɛ la ɛzoanvolɛma ne hɔle zo hanle Gyisɛse anwo edwɛkɛ na bɛyɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ la ayile. Nwanwane gyima ɛhye mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ salole ɛleka biala. Ɛhye ati menli mɔɔ vi azua mɔɔ bikye Gyɛlusalɛm azo la vale bɛ wuleravolɛma rale manle ɛzoanvolɛma ne yɛle bɛ ayile. Ɛhye manle ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne anye bolole, yemɔti bɛhyele ɛzoanvolɛma ne na bɛguale bɛ efiade. Noko bɛangyɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne.

Nɔe ne Nyamenle anwumabɔvolɛ bukele efiade anlenkɛ ne, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Anwumabɔvolɛ ne zele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu, na bɛhɔ zo bɛdendɛ bɛhile menli ne.’ Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ ne mɔɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne zoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔye ɛzoanvolɛma ne bɛvi efiade bɛrɛla la, ɛnee bɛnle ɛkɛ ne. Nzinlii menli ne nwunle bɛ kɛ bɛlɛkilehile wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu na bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle Sanhedelene asalo ɛkɛ ne.

Ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne zele kɛ: ‘Bɛmɛ yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ kɛ bɛmmakilehile Gyisɛse anwo debie bieko. Noko bɛva bɛ ngilehilelɛ ne bɛkponde Gyɛlusalɛm amuala.’ Akee ɛzoanvolɛma ne buale kɛ: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛtie Nyamenle kɛ tumivolɛ yɛtɛla sonla.’ Yemɔti bɛhɔle zo bɛhilehilele “edwɛkpa” ne. Asoo yemɔ ɛnle neazo kɛnlɛma mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdi ɔ nzi a?Gyima ne tile 3 kɔdwu 5. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NRENYA ne mɔɔ hoto ɛke la a le Sitivin. Ɔle Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛ mɔɔ ɔdi nɔhalɛ a. Noko nea mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ ye kɛkala a! Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛtoto awolɛ mgbole abɔ ye. Duzu ati a bɛkpɔ Sitivin somaa mɔɔ ɔti bɛlɛyɛ debie ɛtane kpole ɛhye a? Maa yɛnlea.

Ɛnee Nyamenle boa Sitivin maa ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛngulo debie zɛhae, ɔti bɛ nee ye zule kpolera wɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔkilehile menli la anwo. Noko Nyamenle manle Sitivin nyianle nrɛlɛbɛ kpole, na Sitivin manle ɔlale ali kɛ menli ɛhye mɔ kilehile adalɛ ninyɛne. Ɛhye manle bɛvale ɛya kpole kpalɛ. Yemɔti bɛhyele ye, na bɛvɛlɛle menli kɛ bɛrali ɔ nwo dasewia.

Ɛsɔfo kpanyinli ne bizale Sitivin kɛ: ‘Asoo ɛhye mɔ le nɔhalɛ?’ Sitivin luale Baebolo ne anu ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ ɔmanle la azo ɔbuale edwɛkɛ ne. Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne awieleɛ, ɔhilele kɛzi menli ɛtane kpɔle Gyihova ngapezoma ne mɔ mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la. Akee ɔzele kɛ: ‘Bɛle kɛ menli zɔhane ala la. Bɛhu Nyamenle sonvolɛ Gyisɛse yɛɛ bɛtɛdile Nyamenle mɛla ne azo.’

Ɛhye manle ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ɛhye mɔ vale ɛya kpole! Bɛ nwo ndinli hwehwenle bɛ kikilikikili zɛhae. Na akee Sitivin dole ɔ nye anwuma na ɔzele kɛ: ‘Bɛnlea! Menwu kɛ Gyisɛse gyi Nyamenle asa fema zo wɔ anwuma.’ Bɛdele ɛhye la, menli ɛhye vale bɛ sa duoduale bɛ nzo na bɛhɔle Sitivin anwo zo nwee. Bɛhyele ye na bɛhwenle ye bɛhɔle suakpole ne kandiba.

Bɛyeyele bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na bɛvale bɛmanle kpavolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɔɔlo la kɛ ɔnlea zolɛ. Ɛnwu Sɔɔlo ɔ? Akee menli ne bie mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛtoto awolɛ bɛazi Sitivin. Sitivin hotole, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye la, na ɔzɛlɛle Nyamenle kɛ: ‘Gyihova, fa ɛtane ɛhye kyɛ bɛ.’ Ɛnee ɔze kɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne ɛbɛlabɛla bɛ nuhua bie mɔ. Yemɔ anzi Sitivin wule.

Saa awie mɔ yɛ wɔ debie ɛtane a, asoo ɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛyɛ bɛ bie wɔazie ɔ gyakɛ anu anzɛɛ ɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ ɔyɛ bɛ bie? Tɛ mɔɔ Sitivin anzɛɛ Gyisɛse yɛle la ɛne. Ɛnee bɛ ti akunlu le kɛnlɛma maa menli bɔbɔ mɔɔ nee bɛ lile ye ɛtane zo la. Bɛmaa yɛbɔ mɔdenle yɛzukoa bɛ neazo ne.Gyima ne 6:8-15; 7:1-60. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛze ahenle mɔɔ la azɛlɛ ne anwo la? Sɔɔlo ɔ. Kakye kɛ, yemɔ a nleanle menli mɔɔ hunle Sitivin la adɛladeɛ ne azo a. Nea wienyi zɔhane mɔɔ ɛlɛta la! Duzu a ɛlɛsi a?

Bɛhunle Sitivin bɛwiele la, Sɔɔlo lile bɛ ti kɛ ɔkpondɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne yeazɛkye bɛ. Ɔwolole azua nu ɔhɔhwenle bɛ ɔvindele ɔmanle bɛguale bɛ efiade. Ɛdoavolɛma ne anu dɔɔnwo nriandile hɔle azua azua gyɛne zo na bɛbɔle ɔ bo bɛbɔle “edwɛkpa” ne anwo nolo wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Noko Sɔɔlo hɔle azua azua gyɛne zo kɛ ɔkakpondɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne. Kɛkala ɔlɛkɔ Damasekɛse. Na ɔlua adenle ne azo la, debie ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ zile la ɛne:

Arɛlevilɛ nu ala wienyi mɔɔ vi anwumanyunlu la rabɔle yiale Sɔɔlo. Ɔpɛle ɔfinle kɛmɔ yɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Akee ɛnelɛ bie zele kɛ: ‘Sɔɔlo, Sɔɔlo! Duzu ati a ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde a?’ Menli mɔɔ nee Sɔɔlo lua la nwunle wienyi ne na bɛdele ɛnelɛ ne, noko bɛande mɔɔ ɔhanle la abo.

Sɔɔlo bizale kɛ: ‘Awulae, ɛdawɔ nwane ɔ?’

Ɛnelɛ ne buale kɛ: ‘Medame a mele Gyisɛse mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ye kpɔdekpɔde la.’ Gyisɛse zele ɛhye ɔboalekɛ saa Sɔɔlo yɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma kpɔdekpɔde a, Gyisɛse te nganeɛ kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne a bɛlɛyɛ ye kpɔdekpɔde a.

Sɔɔlo akee bizale kɛ: ‘Awulae, duzu a menyɛ a?’

Gyisɛse zele kɛ: ‘Dwazo na kɔ Dɛmasekɛse. Ɛkɛ ne a bɛbaha debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la bɛahile wɔ a.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ Sɔɔlo dwazole na ɔbukele ɔ nye la, ɛnee ɔngola ɔnwu ɛhwee. Ɛnee ɔ nye ɛzi! Yemɔti menli mɔɔ nee ye lua la sosɔle ɔ sa bɛ nee ye hɔle Dɛmasekɛse.

Gyisɛse akee dendɛle hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la anu ko na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Ananayase, Dwazo. Kɔ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Fɔɔnwo la azo. Kɔ Dwudase sua nu na biza awie bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɔɔlo la. Meye ye kɛ ɔrayɛ me sonvolɛ titile.’

Ananayase diele ye. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔnwunle Sɔɔlo la, ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale ɔ ti zo na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Awulae ɛzoa me ɛ nwo ɛke amaa wɔanwu debie bieko na sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne ara ɛ nwo zo.’ Ɛkɛ ne ala debie mɔɔ le kɛ fɛlɛ nwo abonle la vi Sɔɔlo anye zo guale aze, na ɔnwunle debie bieko.

Bɛvale Sɔɔlo bɛlile gyima kpole bɛmanle ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne ɔhilele maanle dɔɔnwo anu menli. Bɛravɛlɛle ye ɛzoanvolɛ Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ yɛbazukoa ɔ nwo debie dɔɔnwo la. Noko mɔɔ lumua la, maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle zoanle Pita kɛ ɔhɔyɛ la.Gyima ne 8:1-⁠4; 9:1-20; 22:6-16; 26:8-20. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐZOANVOLƐ Pita a gyi ɛkɛ ne la, na ɔ gɔnwo mɔ bie mɔ a gyi ɔ nzi la. Na duzu ati a nrenya ne ɛlɛkoto azonle Pita a? Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ zɔ? Ɛze ahenle holɛ ko?

Nrenya ne a le Kɔnileɛse. Ɔle Wulomu ɛlɔne kpanyinli. Ɛnee Kɔnileɛse ɛnze Pita, noko bɛhanle bɛhilele ye kɛ ɔvɛlɛ ye ɔrɛla ye sua nu. Maa yɛnlea kɛzi ɛhye rale ye zɔ la.

Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ lumua la ɛnee le Dwuuma, na Kɔnileɛse ɛnle Dwuunli. Noko ɔsulo Nyamenle, yɛɛ ɔyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ ɔ nyunlu, na ɔyɛ ahunlunyele ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ɔmaa menli. Kenle ko ewiazo anwumabɔvolɛ bie vindele ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Nyamenle anye ɛzɔ mɔɔ wɔyɛ la, na ɔbabua wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ne. Soa menli maa bɛhɔvɛlɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Pita la bɛrɛla. Ɔde Dwɔpa wɔ nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn la sua nu, wɔ nyevile ne anloa ɛkɛ ne.’

Ɛkɛ ne ala, Kɔnileɛse zoanle menli bie kɛ bɛhɔkpondɛ Pita. Aleɛ hyenle, na mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛbikye Dwɔpa la, Pita vole hɔle Saemɔn sua ne ati zo. Wɔ ɛkɛ ne Nyamenle manle Pita dwenlenle kɛ yenwu ɛdanlɛ kpole bie kɛ ɔvi anwuma ɔlɛdwu aze. Nane ngakyile dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛdanlɛ ne anu. Kɛmɔ Nyamenle mɛla ne kile la, ɛnee nane ɛhye mɔ anwo ɛnde kɛ bɛdi, noko ɛnelɛ bie zele kɛ: ‘Pita, dwazo. Ku bie di.’

Pita buale kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ! Debie mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la metɛdile bie ɛlɛ.’ Noko ɛnelɛ ne buale Pita kɛ: ‘Debie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛde nwolɛ la mmaka kɛ nwolɛ ɛnde.’ Ɛhye zile fane nsa. Mekɛ mɔɔ Pita ɛlɛdwenledwenle mɔɔ ɔ muala kile la anwo la, menli ne mɔɔ Kɔnileɛse zoanle bɛ la rale sua nu ɛkɛ ne na bɛbizale Pita abo zo.

Pita dwule aze na ɔzele kɛ: ‘Ahenle mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ye la a le medame. Na bɛ ɛdialɛ nu ɛ?’ Mɔɔ menli ne hilehilele nuhua kɛ anwumabɔvolɛ bie zele Kɔnileɛse kɛ ɔvɛlɛ Pita ɔrɛla ye sua nu la, Pita kponlenle zo kɛ ɔ nee bɛ kɛhɔ. Aleɛ hyenle la Pita nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ hɔle kɛ bɛkakpɔla Kɔnileɛse wɔ Sizalia.

Ɛnee Kɔnileɛse nee ye sua nu amra nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ ɛwie yia. Mekɛ mɔɔ Pita rale la, Kɔnileɛse hɔyiale ye. Ɔdule ɔdɔle Pita agyakɛ anu na ɔzonlenle ye, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Na Pita zele ye kɛ: ‘Dwazo; na medame mele sonla ala.’ Ɛhɛe, Baebolo ne da ye ali kɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛhoto na yɛkɛzonle sonla. Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsonle Gyihova angomekye ala.

Pita akee hanle edwɛkɛ ne hilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyia la. Pita zele kɛ: ‘Menwu ye kɛ Nyamenle die menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛsonle ye la to nu.’ Mɔɔ ɔ nloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛtendɛ la, Nyamenle zoanle ye sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne manle ɔrale bɛ nwo zo, na menli ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛka aneɛ ngakyile. Ɛhye zinle Dwuu ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ nee Pita rale la anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛdwenlenle kɛ Dwuuma angomekye ala a Nyamenle die bɛ to nu a. Yemɔti ɛhye manle bɛnwunle ye kɛ Nyamenle ɛmbu menli bie mɔ kɛ bɛle kpalɛ anzɛɛ bɛ nwo hyia Nyamenle kpalɛ tɛla menli gyɛne. Asoo yemɔ ɛnle debie kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ muala yɛkakye a?Gyima ne 10:1-48; 11:1-18; Yekile 19:10. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

KPAVOLƐ ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke kɛ ɔgyi ɛzoanvolɛ Pɔɔlo anwo ɛkɛ ne la a le Temɔte. Temɔte nee ye abusua ne de Lesetɛla. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Yunaesi yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nla Loyese.

Mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ba Lesetɛla la ɛne. Kɛyɛ ɛvolɛ ko mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la, Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase lumua dule adenle rahanle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ɛke. Na kɛkala Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo Saelase ɛzia ɛra bieko.

Ɛze mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka ahile Temɔte a? ‘Ɛbahulo kɛ ɛkɛboka me nee Saelase anwo ɔ? Yɛbahola yɛalua wɔ moalɛ zo yɛaha edwɛkɛ ne yɛahile menli mɔɔ wɔ moamoa la.’

Temɔte buale kɛ: ‘Ɛhɛe, mebahulo kɛ mekɛhɔ.’ Yemɔti ɛhye anzi mekɛ ekyi, Temɔte gyakyile ye abusua ne ɛkɛ na ɔ nee Pɔɔlo nee Saelase hɔle. Noko kolaa na yɛazukoa bɛ adendulɛ ne anwo debie la, maa yɛnlea mɔɔ ɛnee Pɔɔlo ɛlɛyia ye la. Gyisɛse yele ɔ nwo hilele ye wɔ Dɛmasekɛse adenle ne azo la ye ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ 17 ɛne.

Kakye kɛ, Pɔɔlo rale Dɛmasekɛse kɛ ɔba yeayɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne kpɔdekpɔde, noko kɛkala ɔdaye mumua ne ɔle ɛdoavolɛ! Nzinlii kpɔvolɛma yɛle kɛ bɛku Pɔɔlo ɔboalekɛ bɛngulo ye ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse anwo la. Noko ɛdoavolɛma ne boale Pɔɔlo manle ɔnriandile. Bɛvale ye bɛwulale kɛndɛne nu na bɛdwulale ye wɔ suakpole ne bane ne anzi.

Ɛhye anzi Pɔɔlo hɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ Anteɔko. Ɛke a bɛlumua bɛvɛlɛle Gyisɛse ɛdovolɛma ne Keleseɛnema a. Akee bɛzoanle Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase bɛvile Anteɔko kɛ bɛdu adenle bɛhɔha edwɛkɛ ne wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ maanɔne la azo. Azua mɔɔ bɛhɔle zolɛ la ko a le Lesetɛla, mɔɔ le Temɔte sua zo la.

Akee, kɛyɛ ɔ nzi ɛvolɛ ko, Pɔɔlo ziale rale Lesetɛla wɔ adendulɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la azo. Mɔɔ Temɔte nee Pɔɔlo nee Saelase vile ɛkɛ ne la, ɛze ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhɔle a? Nea azɛkɛlata ne azo, na maa yɛnleɛnlea ɛleka ne mɔ bie. Mɔɔ lumua la, bɛhɔle Ayekoneɛm mɔɔ bikye la azo, akee bɛhɔle sua mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Anteɔko la azo. Yemɔ anzi bɛhɔle Tulowase mɔɔ wɔ ye anwuma la azo, akee bɛhɔle Felepae, Tɛsalonaeka yɛɛ Bɛlia. Ɛnwu Atɛnse wɔ azɛkɛlata ne azo ɔ? Pɔɔlo hanle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ. Yemɔ anzi bɛvale ɛvolɛ ko ne foa bɛhanle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ Kɔlente. Awieleɛ kolaa ne bɛdɛnlanle Ɛfɛsɛse ekyii. Akee bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛziale bɛrale Sizalia, na bɛhɔle bɛhɔdwule Anteɔko, ɛkɛ ne a Pɔɔlo dɛnlanle a.

Yemɔti Temɔte dule adenle mayɛlɛ ɛya ɛya dɔɔnwo boale Pɔɔlo manle ɔbɔle “edwɛkpa” ne nolo na ɔbɔle Keleseɛne asafo dɔɔnwo abo. Saa ɛyɛ kpanyinli a, asoo ɛbayɛ Nyamenle sonvolɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ kɛ Temɔte ɔ?Gyima ne 9:19-30; 11:19-26; tile 13 kɔdwu 17; 18:1-22. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

OO! OO! Boni a ɛlɛsi wɔ ɛke a? Kpavolɛ ne mɔɔ la azɛlɛ nwo ɛke la ɛboda kpole ɔ? Nea! menli mɔɔ vi sua ne anu ɛlɛfinde la ko a le Pɔɔlo! Ɛnwu Temɔte noko wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɔ? Asoo kpavolɛ ne vi nvɛzɛlɛ ne anu a dɔle aze a?

Ɛhɛe, mɔɔ zile la ala ɛne. Ɛnee Pɔɔlo ɛlɛtendɛ ahile mediema ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Tulowase ɛke la. Ɛnee ɔze kɛ ɔnrɛnwu bɛ bieko wɔ mekɛ tendenle bie anu ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ye alehyenlɛ ne ɔbava ɛlɛne yeahɔ. Yemɔti ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔdendɛle dedee alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli.

Kpavolɛ ɛhye mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yutekɛse la ɛnee de nvɛzɛlɛ ne anloa, na ɔlafele. Ɔvi nvɛzɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛbolɔnsam nzɛzo nsa ne azo la anu ɔdɔle aze! Yemɔti ɛkola ɛnwu deɛ mɔɔ ɔti menli ne ɛyɛ basaa la. Mɔɔ menli ne manle kpavolɛ ne zo la, ɛnee ɔle kɛ mɔɔ bɛzuzule la ala. Ɛnee yewu!

Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nwunle ye kɛ kpavolɛ ne ɛwu la, ɔbutule ɔ nwo zo na ɔbɛlale ye. Akee ɔzele kɛ: ‘Bɛgyakyi mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la. Ɔtɛwule!’ Na amgba noko ɛnee ɔtɛwule! Ɔle nwanwane debie! Pɔɔlo ɛmaa yenyia ngoane bieko! Menli dɔɔnwo ne anye liele.

Bɛ muala bɛhɔle anwuma ne bieko na bɛhɔlile aleɛ. Pɔɔlo hɔle zo dendɛle hilele menli ne toonwo alehyenlɛ. Noko ɛbahola wɔalie wɔali kɛ Yutekɛse anlafe bieko! Akee Pɔɔlo, Temɔte yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛtu adenle ne la hɔvole ɛlɛne ne anu. Ɛze ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛkɔ a? Ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛfa ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ adendulɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa la yeara awieleɛ a, na ɛnee ɔlɛba sua nu. Wɔ adendulɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee Pɔɔlo ɛdɛnla Ɛfɛsɛse sua ne angomekye azo ɛvolɛ nsa. Yemɔti ɛnee adendulɛ ɛhye bɔbɔ le tendenle tɛla ye adendulɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la.

Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛne ne vile Tulowase la, ɔhɔgyinlanle ekyii wɔ Maelitɛse. Kɛmɔ ɛkɛ ne nee Ɛfɛsɛse anwa biala la ati, Pɔɔlo zoanle manle bɛhɔvɛlɛle mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ asafo ne anu la kɛ bɛrɛla Maelitɛse amaa yeahola yeadendɛ yeahile bɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ a. Nzinlii, mɔɔ mekɛ dwule kɛ ɛlɛne ne kɔ la, nea alɔbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle bɛ kɛ bɛnwunle kɛ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛkɔ a!

Awieleɛ kolaa ne ɛlɛne ne ziale rale Sizalia. Mekɛ mɔɔ Pɔɔlo wɔ ɛdoavolɛ Felepe sua nu wɔ ɛke la, ngapezonli Agabɛse bɔle Pɔɔlo kɔkɔ. Ɔzele kɛ saa Pɔɔlo kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a bɛbado ye efiade. Na amgba noko, mɔɔ zile la ɛne. Akee mɔɔ Pɔɔlo lale efiade ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ Sizalia la, bɛvale ye bɛhɔle Wulomu kɛ bɛkali ye edwɛkɛ wɔ Wulomuma tumivolɛ Siza anyunlu. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ zile wɔ Wulomu adendulɛ ne anu la.Gyima ne tile 19 kɔdwu 26. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Ɛlɛne Ne Nwenle Wɔ Bɔra Bie Azo
data.contenido:
NEA! ɛlɛne ne ɛbɔ! Yebubu bɔkɔɔ! Ɛnwu menli ne mɔɔ ɛwulu ɛgua nzule ne anu la? Bie mɔ ɛra file zo dɛbadɛba. Asoo Pɔɔlo agyi ɛkɛ ne la? Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ ɛdo ye la.

Kakye kɛ, bɛdole Pɔɔlo efiade wɔ Sizalia ɛvolɛ nwiɔ. Akee bɛvale ɔdaye nee pilizama bie mɔ bɛvole ɛlɛne nu, na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkɔ Wulomu. Mɔɔ bɛdɛlale Kiliti bɔra ne la, ahumu kpole bie bɔle bɛ. Anwoma ne bɔle ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ ɛnee menli ne ɛngola ɛnga ɛlɛne ne a. Na ɛnee bɛngola bɛnnwu sɛnzɛne ne wɔ alehyenlɛ nu anzɛɛ nwɔlɔra ne mɔ wɔ nɔɔzo. Awieleɛ kolaa, mɔɔ kenle dɔɔnwo pɛle nu la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nuhua la anwo vɔle bɔkɔɔ kɛ yeannyia yɛanyɛ boɛ, bɛbawu.

Akee Pɔɔlo dwazole gyinlanle na ɔzele kɛ: ‘Awie biala ɛnrɛminli ye ngoane; ɛlɛne ye ala a bazɛkye a. Nɔe, Nyamenle anwumabɔvolɛ rale me nwo ɛke na ɔzele me kɛ, “Pɔɔlo, mmasulo! Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛgyinla Wulomu tumivolɛ Siza anyunlu. Ɔlua zo Nyamenle ɛva bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee wɔ lua nyevile ye anye la amuala ngoane ɛhyɛ wɔ.”’

Kɛyɛ alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli wɔ kenle 14 ne anzi mɔɔ ahumu ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtu la azo, gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la nwunle kɛ bɛlɛbikye ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnle kuma la! Kɛmɔ bɛzulole kɛ bɛkɛhɔfofo awolɛ zo wɔ awozinli ne anu la ati, bɛdwulale bɛ sɛkɛ ne mɔ azule nu. Aleɛ hyenle la bɛnwunle ɛnwea. Bɛyɛle kɛ bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛahɔnwe ɛlɛne ne wɔ ɛkɛ.

Mɔɔ bɛbikyele ɛnwea ne anloa la, ɛlɛne ne ati hɔminli ɛnwea nu mɔɔ bɛtu ɔ bo a ɔndu fee a. Akee azɛlɛkye ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbu yeazi ɔ bo ne, na ɛlɛne ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbubu. Sogya kpanyinli ne zele kɛ: ‘Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze weɛ la ɛweɛ ɛhɔ file zo. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la, bɛsesa ndaboa ne mɔɔ ɛlɛtudu ahɔ la bie na bɛli bɛ nzi.’ Na mɔɔ bɛyɛle la ɛne. Wɔ zɛhae adenle ye azo menli 276 ne amuala mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la dwule aze mɔɔ bɛ nwo ambu ɛbonle, kɛmɔ anwumabɔvolɛ ne vale bɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la.

Bɛfɛlɛ bɔra ne Mɔleta. Menli ne lɛ ahunlunyele kpole, na bɛyɛle menli mɔɔ vi ɛlɛne ne anu dwule aze la boɛ. Mɔɔ maanle nu yɛle kpalɛ la, bɛvale Pɔɔlo bɛvole ɛlɛne gyɛne nu na bɛ nee ye hɔle Wulomu.Gyima ne 27:1-44; 28:1-14. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne mɔɔ gua Pɔɔlo asa la, na nea Wulomu sogya ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbɔ ɔ nwo bane la. Pɔɔlo la efiade wɔ Wulomu. Ɔlɛkendɛ kɔkpula kɛ Wulomu Siza ne kɛzi kpɔkɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ ye la anwo. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔla efiade la, bɛmanle menli adenle kɛ bɛkpɔla ye.

Pɔɔlo hɔle Wulomu la ye kenle nsa anzi ɔdole nrɛlaleɛ kɛ Dwuu adekilevolɛma bie mɔ ɛrɛla ɛranwu ye. Ɔlua ɛhye ati, Dwuuma dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ Wulomu la rale. Pɔɔlo hanle Gyisɛse yɛɛ Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ hilele bɛ. Bie mɔ liele lile na bɛrayɛle Keleseɛnema, noko bie mɔ anlie anli.

Pɔɔlo eza hanle edwɛkɛ ne hilele sogyama ngakyile mɔɔ bɔ ɔ nwo bane la. Wɔ ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛdole ye efiade wɔ ɛke la anu Pɔɔlo hanle edwɛkɛ ne ɔhilele awie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛhola la. Ɔlua ɛhye ati, Siza sua nu amra bɔbɔ dele Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkpa ne, na bie mɔ rayɛle Keleseɛnema. Na ɛyɛvolɛ ɛhye mɔɔ de ɛkponle ne anwo ɛlɛkɛlɛ debie la a le nwane? Ɛbahola wɔabɔ ɛ ti anu wɔaha ɔ? Ɛhɛe, Temɔte ɔ. Temɔte noko lale efiade ɔlua Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔhanle la ati, noko ɔ nwo ɛdɔ ye. Na yera ɛke kɛ ɔba yeraboa Pɔɔlo. Asoo ɛze edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Temɔte ɛlɛkɛlɛ la? Maa yɛnlea.

Ɛkakye Felepae nee Ɛfɛsɛse azua ne mɔ wɔ Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 110 ne anu ɔ? Pɔɔlo boale manle bɛbɔle Keleseɛne asafo dɔɔnwo abo wɔ azua zɔhane mɔ azo. Akee mekɛ mɔɔ ɔla efiade la, Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle ngɛlata hɔmanle Keleseɛnema ɛhye mɔ. Ngɛlata ne mɔ wɔ Baebolo ne anu, na bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Ɛfɛsɛsema nee Felepaema. Pɔɔlo akee ɛlɛka ahile Temɔte mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkɛlɛ bɛkɔmaa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ Keleseɛnema wɔ Felepae la.

Felepaema ɛyɛ Pɔɔlo ahunlunyele kpole. Bɛvale ahyɛlɛdeɛ bɛnwanle ye wɔ efiade ɛke, yemɔti Pɔɔlo ɛlɛda bɛ ase wɔ nwolɛ. Ɛpafulodaetɛse a le sonla ne mɔɔ vale ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne rale a. Noko ɔ nwo dole ye kpole mɔɔ asɛɛ ɔwule a. Kɛkala yede kpɔkɛ bieko na yeziezie ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkɔ ye sua zo. Ɔbava Pɔɔlo nee Temɔte kɛlata ɛhye yeazia ɔ nwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛsia yeahɔ Felepae la.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Pɔɔlo wɔ efiade la ɔhɛlɛle ngɛlata nwiɔ bieko mɔɔ yɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Baebolo ne anu a. Ɔhɛlɛle ko ɔhɔmanle Keleseɛnema mɔɔ wɔ Kɔlɔsae sua ne azo la. Ɛze duma mɔɔ bɛfa bɛfɛlɛ ye la ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Kɔlɔsaema. Ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la le ɔ ti anwo kɛlata mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle ɔ gɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Faelimɔn mɔɔ wɔ Kɔlɔsae la. Kɛlata ne fane Faelimɔn sonvolɛ Onɛsemɛse anwo.

Onɛsemɛse nriandile vile Faelimɔn anwo na ɔrale Wulomu. Wɔ adenle bie azo Onɛsemɛse dele kɛ Pɔɔlo la efiade wɔ ɛke. Ɔrakpɔlale ye, na Pɔɔlo hanle edwɛkɛ ne bie hilele Onɛsemɛse. Yeangyɛ Onɛsemɛse noko rayɛle Keleseɛnli. Akee Onɛsemɛse nlunle ɔ nwo kɛ ɔnriandile a. Ɛhye ati ɛze mɔɔ Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle ye wɔ kɛlata ɛhye anu hɔmanle Faelimɔn a?

Pɔɔlo hanle hilele Faelimɔn kɛ ɔva Onɛsemɛse ɛtane ɔhyɛ ye. Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle kɛ: ‘Melɛsiane ye meamaa yeara ɛ nwo lɔ bieko. Noko kɛkala ɔnle wɔ akɛlɛ angome. Eza ɔle Keleseɛne adiema kulovolɛ.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ Onɛsemɛse ziale hɔle Kɔlɔsae la ɔvale ngɛlata nwiɔ ɛhye ɔziale ɔ nwo ɔhɔle, ɔvale ko ɔmanle Kɔlɔsaema na ɔvale ko ne noko ɔmanle Faelimɔn. Yɛkola yɛnwu kɛzi Faelimɔn anye balie kpole wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye kɛ ye sonvolɛ ne ɛrayɛ Keleseɛnli la.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle Felepaema nee Faelimɔn la, ɛnee amgba ɔlɛ edwɛkɛ kpalɛ bie ɔka ɔkile bɛ. Pɔɔlo hanle hilele Felepaema kɛ: ‘Melɛsoa Temɔte meamaa yeara bɛ nwo lɔ. Noko ɔnrɛhyɛ medame noko mebara mearakpɔla bɛ.’ Na ɔhɛlɛle Faelimɔn kɛ: ‘Kpondɛ dabelɛ sie me.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛgyakyile Pɔɔlo la ɔhɔle ɛleka dɔɔnwo ɔhɔkpɔlale ɔ mediema Keleseɛne mrenya nee mraalɛ. Noko nzinlii bɛdole Pɔɔlo efiade bieko wɔ Wulomu. Mekɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee ɔze kɛ bɛbahu ye. Yemɔti ɔhɛlɛle Temɔte na ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ ɔrɛla ndɛndɛ. Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle kɛ: ‘Meli nɔhalɛ memaa Nyamenle, na Nyamenle bamaa me ahyɛlɛdeɛ.’ Bɛhunle Pɔɔlo la ye ɛvolɛ ekyi anzi, bɛzɛkyele Gyɛlusalɛm bieko, mekɛ ɛhye anu Wulomuma a zɛkyele ye a.

Noko dɔɔnwo tɛbɔ Baebolo ne anu. Gyihova Nyamenle manle ɛzoanvolɛ Dwɔn hɛlɛle ye mbuluku ne mɔ mɔɔ li awieleɛ, mɔɔ Yekile buluku ne boka nwolɛ la. Baebolo buluku ɛhye ka kenlebie anwo edwɛkɛ. Akee maa yɛzukoa mɔɔ bara kenlebie la anwo debie.Gyima ne 28:16-31; Felepaema 1:13; 2:19-30; 4:18-23; Hibuluma 13:23; Faelimɔn 1-25; Kɔlɔsaema 4:7-⁠9; 2 Temɔte 4:7-⁠9. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
